entries.what: Xala developer pages: press/six-senses-xala, community, real-estate, life.xala.com, xala.com
entries.detail: Partial yield (location context): 3,000 acres, five miles of coast, ~65 miles south of Puerto Vallarta, 10 min from Costalegre airport; 'new coastal protection reef' for 'a consistently great wave'; 'surf' page: bay exclusive to residents and guests. No dimensions, coordinates or drawings.

Partial yield (already R3): '3,000 truckloads of boulders from a nearby quarry'; no size, location or plan. Earlier (2026-09-25) the same URL served a tollbit paywall redirect and the archive.org / archive.ph mirrors were blocked; the text was then read through its Yahoo syndication (https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/richard-gere-next-great-role-130000544.html), which gave the same single physical line.
Says he designed 'three additional surfing reefs globally, most recent in the Americas'; does not name Xala or give figures.

entries.what: Esri imagery of the Xala coast (z15 r=6.5 km and z17 r=0.9 km, image 2025-05-23)
entries.where: Esri World Imagery current, centre 19.735,-105.255 and 19.6805,-105.262
entries.detail: Coast between the Xola-Paraman lagoon mouth (19.731,-105.291) and a rocky point at about 19.679,-105.262 is a long beach with surf; no artificial rock works are visible. The rocky point is a natural headland: NOT identified as the Xala reef (location unconfirmed). A submerged boulder reef would not show (assumption A3).

entries.what: papers/ folder for Xala / Mortensen / Costalegre
entries.detail: Only the NSW 2013 review cites Mortensen (2010) CFD surfing paper (p.68, 100); nothing on Xala. Mexico appears in the PDFs only for the Yucatan geotextile reefs (Rendle thesis p.38, 124, 278-280; Blacka et al. 2013 Tables p.75-79, reference p.96), a different project and type; the 2007 Mount Maunganui paper has no text layer; the reef was unveiled in 2026, after all five papers.

entries.what: Surfer magazine Mortensen/Palm Beach and artificial reefs articles
EMODnet Bathymetry DTM 2024 (viewer, REST, ERDDAP) for seabed depth at the reef
entries.where: https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/geoviewer/ ; EMODnet Bathymetry REST depth_sample / ERDDAP bathymetry_dtm_2024 (no coordinate for this reef)
entries.detail: EMODnet covers European seas only; the REST service returns HTTP 204 (empty) at this reef's coordinate (Mexico (Pacific)), so the site is outside the grid. Only two of the 13 reefs are covered (Boscombe, Borth). Do not retry EMODnet for this reef.
